messages.ko: 데뷔 초반에 한터 가서 멤버들 무대 응원했었는데 다시 가서 무대하니까 마음이 새롭다 한터 우리 3번 나갔는데 정작 난 했던 무대가 없던것같아서 아쉬웠는데 오늘 한 풀었다!! 너무 즐거운 무대였어ㅓ오늘 상받게 해줘서 너무 고마워😍 이제 설날인데 즐거운시간 보내구 푹쉬어~ 먹고싶은거 다 먹고! 내가 오늘 커버무대 얼마나 스포하고 싶었는지ㅠ 맘에 들어했으면 좋겠다 열심히 준비했거든…! 헤ㅔ
messages.en: Back when we first debuted, I went to Hanteo to cheer on the members' stage, so going back and performing there myself feels really special. We've been to Hanteo three times, but I always felt a little sad because I never actually had my own stage there. But today I finally fulfilled that!! It was such a fun stage todayㅓ Thank you so much for letting us receive an award today😍 It's Lunar New Year now, so have a wonderful time and get plenty of rest~ Eat everything you want! I seriously wanted to spoil today's cover stage so badlyㅠ I hope you liked it. I worked really hard preparing it…! Hehe.

messages.ko: 아니 오늘 이 착입고 사진을 못찍은거야
messages.en: I couldn't take any proper pictures in this outfit today.
That's the only photo I have...
I'm so sad about it.
Whenever I said, "Take a picture for me!!"
they'd say, "Let's take one together later."
"Okay..."
So I agreed...
Then I asked someone else,
"Take a picture for me!!"
They said, "Let's finish this first and then go."
But then...
I immediately had to go on stage, then do interviews.
...I waited forever and never got to take any pictures.
I think I looked pretty cool today.
I put a lot of thought into my hair too...
Do you like it?
Actually, as soon as I got to the salon today...
I said my concept should be...
"Please make me a decadent, sexy prince."
That's what I asked for.
But when it was finished...
I ended up looking like a cute and elegant madam.
It wasn't the vibe I was going for,
but it felt fresh.
Anyway, it was Hayeon's first cover stage.
At Hanteo...
We performed 'Growl'ㅎㅎ
This was the vibe I was aiming for today.
ㅎㅎㅎ

messages.ko: 옆머리?만 보면 완전 단발 같다 단발로 잘라도 잘 어울리겠당
messages.en: Just looking at the side hair, it totally looks like a bob. I think you'd look good with short hair too.
Right? It's the kind of photo where you can imagine me with a bob.
I want to dye my hair wine red...
Maybe for the next comeback~??
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹ
I should change my image at least once.
As someone who's only had brown hair for two years...
Even though I only had blue hair for about a second...
It almost feels like it was just a dream.
Just from doing that once...
I've been on a campaign to restore my hair ever since.
Back then I thought I'd never bleach my hair again.
During the third round of bleaching I was literally crying.
"Please rinse it out quicklyㅠㅠㅠ"

messages.ko: 두피가 다 화상입어서 벗겨지는 상상을 했어
messages.en: I imagined my scalp getting burned and peeling off.
Maybe bald Hayeon wouldn't be so bad?
Not just bald...
It'd be bald Hayeon with her skin peeling off too...
Anyway, I fell for Fake Love Hayeon.
I need to go watch it again.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
One of the members said it was a secret...
but while watching 'Fake Love' today...
"You looked prettyㅎ"
Then they flirted with me and left.
Oh, we got the right answer.
Anyway, it was a day full of compliments.
So I was happy.
Get lots of rest during the holiday.
Let's meet again after we've all turned into pigs~
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅎㅋㅋㅎㅋㅎ
Good night!!
Haranghae😘
